scope: XLSX automatic preview replacement and feedback ownership
originalBehavior: Pending refresh deactivated the old workbook; paused status disabled its own revision monitor and invalidated the replacement. Restoration reactivated the monitor and caused immediate repeated capture.
fix: Keep actual view activity distinct from temporary interaction blocking. Existing parent pending/operation guards remain; the workbook adds its own current-owner interaction guard and retires/re-registers sources without restarting its reading effect.

checks.name: effective parent regression before fix
checks.failure: Unhidden automatic refresh kept v1 instead of adopting v2. Real hiding case already rejected late adoption.

checks.name: parent repair and existing revision cases

boundary: Parent regression uses mocked React/leaf/IPC and the real FileRevisionMonitor; it is not DOM or native proof.
Real browser failure and repair have separate independent receipts.
CSS and workbook leaf repair are independently recorded.
No runtime, backend, schema, Agent service/model or permission change.
